text.title: A Quantum Scare
text.body: A lab demonstrates an attack on an old signature scheme. Bitcoin falls 40% while developers rush a migration to quantum-safe keys.

wildcards.basis: Doc 40 §D6: NIST disallows pre-quantum schemes after 2035 [A/B]; experts put a CRQC at 28-49% within 10 years [C]; magnitude designed [D]

text.title: Net Electric, Briefly
text.body: A rival's fusion pilot reports net electricity for an afternoon. Multiples jump on the headline, then sag when the plant spends the next quarter offline.

wildcards.basis: Doc 43 §6.6 [D]; doc 45 §Q9: no net electricity announced by Oct 2026, goals walked back [B]; no fusion output before 2038 (the honesty rule)

text.title: A Dry Year
text.body: A dry winter leaves reservoirs low across one region. Hydro and pumped storage run at three-quarters for a year.

wildcards.basis: Designed magnitude [D]; Iceland's Dec 2021 curtailment of interruptible supply on low reservoirs as the shape (doc 40 §Q2 [B])

effect.region: drawn among the regions with your sites

text.title: A Moratorium
text.body: One region pauses new connections for loads over 50 MW while it rewrites its rules. Positions already energised are safe; new ones wait.

wildcards.basis: Doc 45 §Q8: 69+ local bans, statewide bills in 14 states, proposals of 3 months to 4 years [B]; 50 MW from FERC's suggested definition [B]; length drawn U{2..8} [D]

effect.applies_to: new grid-connected assets and network upgrades started while it lasts

text.title: Transformer Shortage
text.body: Large transformers are on allocation for a year. Anything new that needs a grid transformer takes two quarters longer, some four.

wildcards.basis: Doc 45 §Q8: large transformers 128-144 weeks, a 30% supply deficit, up to four years for high-capacity units [B/C]; +2 q (40% of draws +4) designed
